notes.title: Ars Notoria Eastern Game Fest Playtest Concludes — Thank You for Joining Us
notes.content:
Ars Notoria Playtest Concludes

The test has officially ended at 10:00 UTC. We deeply appreciate every piece of feedback and suggestion you've shared during this period — your input plays a crucial role in helping us improve the game. The development team will carefully review all feedback and work hard to deliver a better Ars Notoria in the future.

We look forward to seeing you again in the next test!

Thank you all for your patience and support!

Playtest Period
April 24, 2:00 AM – May 6 (PDT)

Feedback & Bug Hunt Event
To thank you for participating, we’ll be giving away serveal full release keys to the most helpful bug reporters or feedback providers!
English feedback will be collected in our #playtest-bug-reports channel on Discord.
For full event details, please join our official Discord.

If you’re interested in joining the PlayTest, we invite you to fill out the registration form. Eligible players will be contacted promptly. You can also sign up for the Playtest through Steam’s “Request Access” feature. However, please note that we are unable to control which players get selected via the Steam platform.
Registration Form

Build Update
Story

 Unlocked the main story arc for the Training Camp.

Tutorials

 The "Setting Up Camp" tutorial has now been changed to a main quest, as it provides a transition to the Training Camp quest line.
 Fixed an issue where tutorial windows might not appear in certain cases.
 Fixed an issue where loading a game with a tutorial quest in progress would redisplay the tutorial window.

World

 Unlocked the Training Camp location and the surrounding areas in the Woodlands.
 Added Waystones, which can be used as fast travel points throughout the game world.
 Added Notice Boards that offer optional side quests.
 The respawn point is now available for fast travel from anywhere on the map when fast travel is enabled in the server settings. 
 Fast travel cannot be used while in combat, mounted, or inside a dungeon or building.
 Added faction reputation system.

Characters

 Added Attack Speed character stat.
 Added Approval mechanics for NPCs.
 Added daily routines for NPCs.
 Unlocked character-switching mechanics.
 Unlocked combat classes.
 The appearance of generated NPCs is now saved across game worlds and synchronized between the host and clients.
 Fixed an issue where the interaction tooltip was displayed for NPCs without available dialogue.

Multiplayer

 Reworked multiplayer synchronization for pre-built containers and items. Their contents are now properly shared between the host and clients.
 Fixed an issue where dead bodies in the Destroyed Village were not displayed for clients.
 Fixed an issue where moving containers for clients might cause them to appear frozen in mid-air.
 Fixed an issue where campfires might not display fire effects for clients.

Server Settings

 Added an option to customize fast travel settings. The available modes are:
[olist]
 Default - Fast travel is only allowed when interacting with an activated waystone.
 Global - Fast travel is allowed from anywhere in the game world to a selected waystone.
 Disabled - Waystones cannot be activated, and fast travel is unavailable.
[/olist]
Save Games

 Added an option to load game world backups.
 Added an option to restore backups for character saves with missing or invalid data.
 Added visual indicators for character save files that contain invalid data.
 Fixed an issue where creating a new character in an existing world could use an incorrect save slot.

Combat

 Added an option to block while using ranged weapons. Holding Alt + RMB activates blocking.
 Fixed an issue where aiming with ranged weapons could be interrupted near campfires.

Resources

 Small shrubs can now be destroyed and will provide a bit of softwood.
 Increased manual harvesting speed for basic trees and resource deposits by 30–50%.
 Rebalanced harvesting skill experience gain by increasing experience requirements for higher levels.

Items

 Added a new item type, Recipes, which can be used to unlock crafting and cooking recipes.
 Added craftable and refillable Healing Potions.
 Added a new unique armor set, the Redthorn Armor. It is awarded for outstanding achievements during training at the camp.
 Improved the physics interactions of pickable items.
 Fixed an issue where the amount of gold found in containers could be lower than intended.

Customization

 Added beards and moustaches.
 Added face and body tattoos.
 Improved eye textures.
 Fixed an issue where default clothing and hair colors could display incorrect values when returning to the Character Selection menu.
 Fixed an issue where canceling new character creation caused the selected character's appearance to display incorrectly.
 Fixed an issue where customization slider values might not reset to default when creating a new character after selecting an existing one.
 Fixed an issue where modifications to an existing character's appearance might not be applied.

User Interface

 Unlocked the Character tab in the Journal.
 Added a "Travel to Respawn" button to the Map menu.
 Fixed an issue where the map and minimap had a lower resolution than intended.
 Fixed an issue where a selected completed quest might be highlighted incorrectly in the Quest Journal.
 Fixed an issue where completed quest objectives may have incorrect formatting after loading the game.
 Fixed an issue where the final objective of a skipped quest was incorrectly marked as in progress after loading the game.
 Various formatting fixes for the dialogue UI.

Status Effects

 Diseases can now be cured by the Healer at the Training Camp.

Other

 Water sources, such as wells, can now also be used to refill potions.

notes.title: Major Update: totorial storyline. Join the latest playtest!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42814198/6a4777697b2998d9e61bbb7b759df8b647730c97.jpg

Greetings!
We’re thrilled to announce that Ars Notoria will be showcased at the Eastern Game Fest! This event marks an exciting opportunity for players to dive into the mystical world we’ve been refining since our last playtest.

What’s New?
Since our previous test, we’ve implemented numerous optimizations and gameplay enhancements based on community feedback. Today, we’re proud to reveal that Ars Notoria will host a limited-time PlayTest during the Eastern Game Fest!

PlayTest Details & Key Updates

 Test Period
April 23rd – May 6th (PDT)

 How to Participate
If you’re interested in joining the PlayTest, we invite you to fill out the registration form. Eligible players will be contacted promptly. You can also sign up for the Playtest through Steam’s “Request Access” feature. However, please note that we are unable to control which players get selected via the Steam platform. Registration Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc2kQ1yFc0QVi5bFMOq92d6glksHjSUIp-KWgypvSIvIR-1tA/viewform?


 Major Additions & Improvements

Training Camp Story Arc
A brand-new storyline set in the Training Camp is now available. It introduces the Holy Guard faction, along with unique NPCs, quests, and an expanded area for exploration. We've also added daily routines for most characters, new dialogues, and additional interaction options to enrich the experience.

Character Switching Mechanics
Progressing through the main Training Camp quests unlocks new mechanics that let you form a squad of up to four characters, allowing you to switch between them freely—both during combat and while exploring.

Combat Classes
After completing basic combat training at the camp, you'll gain access to six combat classes. These classes offer new ways to develop and customize your character's abilities and playstyle.

Waystones
Waystones are magical structures that enable fast travel between locations. We've also added an option to return to your selected respawn point via the World Map. Fast travel is enabled by default, but customizable settings are available when starting a new game, allowing you to disable or adjust how it functions.

Notice Boards
Found in settlements and outposts, notice boards offer access to side quests given by nearby NPCs.

Reputation & Approval Systems
With the introduction of the Holy Guard faction and new characters, we’ve implemented faction reputation and character approval systems. These affect faction management progression and influence character recruitment.

Quality-of-Life Improvements
Based on feedback from previous testing phases, we’ve added several improvements to enhance gameplay, including:
1. The ability to block enemy attacks while using ranged weapons
2. Map indicators for hard-to-find quest objectives
3. The option to harvest wood from small shrubs
4. Increased speed for manual resource gathering
5. Improved stability and the ability to load backup saves of your game world

Character Customization
The new version offers expanded character customization options, including beards, mustaches, and face and body tattoos.

New Items and Equipment
The Training Camp also introduces new items and rewards. You can also earn a unique armor set by completing optional objectives during training quests.


Join the Mystical Journey!
This PlayTest offers a chance to experience Ars Notoria’s evolving world firsthand. Whether you’re a returning player or a newcomer, your feedback will shape the path to perfection.
Thank you for your support, and see you at the Eastern Game Fest! 
Join our official Disocord: https://discord.gg/bYNb6kmw

— The Ars Notoria Dev Team

notes.title: Thank You for Participating in the 2nd Ars Notoria Multiplayer Playtest
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
 
The second multiplayer test of Ars Notoria ended on February 10th at 10:30 AM UTC. We sincerely thank you for exploring this world, battling its dangers, and sharing your insights with us.

Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping the future of Ars Notoria. Next, we will focus on incorporating the valuable suggestions we've gathered and optimizing the game. Once these updates are nearing completion, we will share them with you in our upcoming announcements.

If you’ve enjoyed your time in this world, please add the game to your wishlist—your support fuels our journey forward.

Thank you for being part of this tale, and stay tuned for updates!

————————————————————————————

Original announcement

Hey everyone!

We haven’t spoken for a while, but it doesn't mean we haven't been working on optimizing new content of Ars Notoria. Now we’re thrilled to announce that the second round of multiplayer testing is about to begin. Want to join the adventure? Fill out the questionnaire to participate.

The latest update is here, filled with new content, challenges, and quality-of-life improvements. We hope you'll grab your gear, gather your allies, and explore what’s new.

The Dark Forest Beckons: Expanded Exploration
We invite you to venture deeper into the mysterious Dark Forest. Previously, only a portion of this zone was accessible, but now, the entire Dark Forest awaits your exploration. Discover new Places of Interest, such as Altars for summoning Enthralled creatures, the eerie Crypts filled with skeletons and undead spiders, and the treacherous Spider Nests. Explore perilous dungeons, face a variety of new enemies, and uncover hidden secrets. Every corner of the Dark Forest is designed to challenge the brave and reward the curious.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42814198/1e0d958668efb0acff77eb3bf1b2406f3ed04a07.png

Forge, Form, Flourish: New Research Tools
For base-building enthusiasts, we’ve added a new research stations for the Engineering profession.
Get ready to supercharge your faction’s resource harvesting and management! This update brings shiny new Engineering tools, unlocking a treasure trove of technologies to boost your resource management. With these powerful upgrades, you'll be improving your base like a true mastermind!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42814198/4a3bb6156d1975453215935e084c260106075a76.png

New Enemies: Undead Spiders lurking in the Dark Forest
We’ve got a creepy new surprise for you in the Dark Forest: Undead Spiders!
That’s right, the Dark Forest just got spookier. Prepare yourselves for three terrifying new types of eight-legged nightmares, straight from your worst arachnid nightmares:
1. Biters – Fast, grotesque undead spiders with skull-like bodies and glowing eyes. They may not be tough individually, but their swarming speed makes them deadly.
2. Crawlers – Massive, armored spiders with human skulls fused into their bodies. They have a venomous stinger that paralyzes foes, making them a real threat in tight spaces.
3. Spinners – Enormous, magical spiders that shoot webs with pinpoint accuracy. Strong and agile, they can trap you in their webs before delivering a crushing blow.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42814198/b1d9e8aa472f8927aafdcdbd3d86b229cf882679.png

Flatter Terrain: Perfect Spots for Your New Base!
We’ve rolled out some spacious new flat terrain patches—perfect for building your dream base right near the starting zone, or anywhere else you fancy! Oh, and the Dark Forest biome just got a makeover too, with basic resources like stone and iron ore popping up, plus a few extra surprises. Time to get building and resource-hunting!

Empower Your Heroine: Female Character Customization
We’re excited to announce that female character customization is now available! Tailor your warrior's look with a variety of options, from hairstyles and facial features. Express yourself in the harsh world of survival like never before. Whether you’re crafting, fighting, or leading your faction, do it with style.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42814198/8ec30016aeb98990167247271d4f3fc45939b98c.jpg

Quality of Life Improvements: Streamlining Survival
We’ve listened to your feedback and made several quality-of-life enhancements:
- Easier Harvesting: We've added a new option in the settings that allows you to harvest resources with a single click, instead of holding the interaction button or repeatedly clicking it.
- Adjustable Processing Speed: Server settings now allow you to adjust processing speeds, giving you more control over your gameplay experience.
- Multiplayer Fixes and Improvements: Minimap fog progress, character icons, and custom markers are now properly synchronized between players, along with many other enhancements to improve the multiplayer experience.
- Testing Functionality Updates: We've improved the testing experience with some shiny new features! You can now load character backups directly in-game, just in case anything goes wrong. Additionally, we've implemented extra safeguards to ensure your data remains safe and secure!

Don't forget to fill out the questionnaire to get access to try all the latest updates for yourself. The test will begin on January 21st at 3 AM (UTC). If you have any ideas or suggestions for the game, please feel free to leave a message or join our official Discord. We'd love to hear your thoughts!

notes.title: Faction Management Update
notes.content:
Quests

 Added a continuation to the Missing Villagers main quest. 
Since there are changes to the quest's implementation, its state will be reset in existing save games.
 Added more quests to the Destroyed Village questline:
[olist]
 New Beginnings
 The Broken Mill
[/olist]
 Fixed an issue where Missing Villagers quest progress might not be properly saved.
 Fixed an issue where dialogue with the rescued villager couldn't be initiated in some cases.
 Fixed an issue where rescued villagers might respawn in imprisoned state after loading the game.
 Fixed an issue where the progress of certain intermediate tasks in quests was not saved properly.

Factions

 Added the Faction Management system.
 The main character can create a faction after rescuing villagers during the "Missing Villagers" quest.
 Faction members can be assigned workplaces and given tasks.

Tutorials

 Added tutorials for the Faction Management system.

Prebuilt Houses

 Destroyed village houses can now be rebuilt through the Faction Management system.
 Rebuilt houses can be upgraded with various furniture and equipment.
 Faction members can be assigned to live in the rebuilt houses.
 Fixed an issue where prebuilt houses could be entered by clicking on any part of the building, instead of only the door.
 Fixed an issue where tables in prebuilt houses had an incorrect offset from the floor.

Character Customization

 Added an option to change the character's appearance in-game by using Wardrobe furniture.
 A faction member's appearance can be customized once they are assigned housing with a wardrobe.
 Fixed an issue where NPC portraits in the dialogue UI could display incorrect clothing colors.
 Fixed an issue where character customization slider values might not be loaded correctly when modifying an existing character.
 Fixed an issue where hair color could reset when switching between different hairstyles.
 Fixed an issue where editing an existing character's hair or clothing color wouldn't update until the style was switched.

Resources

 Fixed an issue where resource deposits might not be detected by the auto-harvesters upon placement, requiring re-entering the dungeon to start production.
 Fixed an issue where plantable crops could not grow on Flat Ground modules.
 Fixed an issue where honey could only be collected from one buildable beehive per day.

Building

 Added Engineer's Workbench which unlocks Woodcutting, Mining, and Quarrying research projects.
 Multiple processing tools can now be placed near a productivity tool (for example, several Circular Saws near a Debarker), but by default, only one will receive the bonus. 
With the corresponding technology research, all of them will receive productivity bonuses.
 Added arrow indicators to show if the build part is within the range of an automation tool when placed.
 Added buildable fences:
[olist]
 Old Fence
 Log Fence
 Farm Fence
 Wattle Fence
 Small Fence
 Picket Fence
 Iron Fence
[/olist]
 Added new buildable furniture and decorations:
[olist]
 Cotton Curtains
 Round Rug
 Flower Boxes
 Door Lock
 Shutters
 Small Desk
 Wardrobe
 Bookcase
[/olist]
 Lanterns for village houses now also require the Oil resource.
 Stone ovens now also require the Fuel resource.
 Building within the Destroyed Village zone is now possible.
 Tile Mold tool was renamed to Tile Press.
 Fixed an issue where the craftable bed required fabric materials of an incorrect rarity level.
 Fixed an issue where furniture objects might not refund the full amount of building materials upon destruction.
 Fixed an issue where the built stone oven could disappear after reloading the game.

Research

 Added Engineer research functionality. 
Research grants bonuses to various harvesting and crafting professions.
 Constructing multiple research tools of the same type increases the global research speed for corresponding projects. 
For example, building additional Engineer's Workbenches boosts the research speed for Woodcutting, Mining, and Quarrying projects.
 Rebalanced the maximum productivity of non-upgraded automation tools to align with research project bonuses. 
Previously, most tools had a maximum productivity of 400%, but now they start at 200% and can increase up to 400% through the corresponding research.
 Woodcutting research projects:
[olist]
 Whipsaw - Increases the base processing speed of soft lumber by 50%.
 Tar Refinery - Increases the base processing speed of pitch by 50%.
 Logging Wheel - Increases the base storage capacity for softwood by 25.
 Lumber Rack - Increases the base storage capacity for soft lumber by 25.
 Tar Tank - Increases the base storage capacity for pitch by 25.
 Log Splitter - Allows connecting multiple processing tools of each type to Debarkers.
 Log Flume - Increases the maximum productivity of Sawmills by 100%.
[/olist]
 Mining research projects:
[olist]
 Ingot Mold - Increases the base processing speed of iron ingots by 50%.
 Ventilation - Increases the base harvesting speed of copper ore by 50%.
 Wheelbarrow - Increases the base storage capacity for iron ore by 25.
 Foundry - Increases the base storage capacity for copper ore by 25.
 Iron Works - Increases the base storage capacity for iron ingots by 25.
 Ore Loader - Allows connecting multiple processing tools of each type to Stamp Mills.
 Mine Hoist - Increases the maximum productivity of Drainage Pumps by 100%.
[/olist]
 Quarrying research projects:
[olist]
 Plug and Feather - Increases the base processing speed of sandstone by 50%.
 Crane - Increases the base harvesting speed of peat by 50%.
 Stone Sled - Increases the base storage capacity for sandstone by 25.
 Block Lift - Increases the base storage capacity for sandstone blocks by 25.
 Minecart - Increases the base storage capacity for peat by 25.
 Stone Cutter - Allows connecting multiple processing tools of each type to Stone Saw Machines.
 Gyratory Crusher - Increases the maximum productivity of Rock Crushers by 100%.
[/olist]

Equipment

 Fixed an issue where Archon Boots applied healing on attacks instead of evasion.

User Interface

 Added a minimap icon for the player's mount.
 Slightly reordered harvesting skills, placing the Farming skill higher on the list to better match the unlock and research order.
 Fixed an issue where the tutorial window could be opened while in the main menu.
 Fixed an issue where ability or spell quickslots were not removed from the quickslot panel after being dragged out and switching panels.
 Fixed an issue where the build part customization menu could remain open after destroying an object or returning to the main menu.
 Fixed an issue where minion command quickslots might not highlight upon activation in certain cases (e.g., after closing the Inventory menu).
 Fixed an issue where selecting a cooking recipe with missing resources, then canceling the cooking process, could add an extra ingredient to the inventory.

Other

 Fixed an issue where Cutthroat bandits could wear a helmet instead of a mask.

Hotfix 1

 Disabled character portrait animations as they may negatively affect performance.
 Fixed an issue where Backpacks and Tool Bags only had 30 slots unlocked instead of 60.
 Fixed an issue where wheat was consumed by the Manger tool even when leather or fat storage was full.
 Fixed an issue where the Manger's interaction with the Leather Rack and/or Stove could produce an incorrect amount of resources.
 Fixed an issue where Leather Rack and Stove production might not automatically resume after reloading the game.
 Fixed an issue where the resource icon in the harvesting tools UI could be dragged with 0 resource quantity and disappear afterward.

notes.title: Demo Build 0.1.0.3b
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! This patch is aimed at fixing various issues with the newly introduced systems (such as backpacks, lanterns, building inside dungeons, and switching quickslot panels) as well as implementing several performance optimizations.

Quests

 Tutorial quests can now be skipped when starting a new game and will be marked as completed in the Journal.

Dungeons

 Fixed various issues related to entering dungeons that could lead to incorrect generation.

Mounts

 Mounts now become immune to friendly fire upon reaching 300 Affection, instead of 500 as previously required.

Resources

 Animal hides now provide varying amounts of leather when processed, depending on their size:
[olist]
 Rat, Fox, Goat, and Sheep hides provide 1 leather.
 Pig, Boar, and Wolf hides provide 2 leather.
 Cow, Deer, and Bear hides provide 3 leather.
[/olist]
 Resources are no longer reset when an existing character migrates to a new game world.
 Wild beehives now have their visual and sound effects disabled after honey is collected, making it easier to identify which beehives have already been harvested.
 Added a message indicating that animal hides or fats that were converted into resources for processing cannot be retrieved.
 Fixed an issue where auto-harvesters built inside dungeons might not activate after loading the game in some cases.
 Fixed an issue where resource income/expenditure might not have correct values after migrating the character to a different game world.
 Fixed an issue where the Manger's resource production could reset before yielding any resources.

Equipment

 Fixed an issue where the off-hand slot might not get emptied after unequipping a two-handed weapon.
 Fixed an issue where the auto-storing option might not work correctly after swapping the backpack between equipment slots.
 Fixed an issue where the equipment slot auto-storing wasn't disabled after dropping the backpack.
 Fixed an issue where dragging a quickslot of an equipped item into the container could lead to duplicating this item.
 Fixed an issue where Treasure Map items could disappear after being transferred to a container.
 Fixed an issue where tool damage bonuses could be incorrectly applied to weapon damage.
 Fixed an issue where a tool icon might be highlighted after loading the game, even if it wasn't equipped.

Crafting

 The pouch container recipe now requires fibers instead of fabric and can be crafted earlier.
 Simplified the recipe unlocks for various encampment equipment:
[olist]
 Bags are now unlocked after discovering fabric or crafting a pouch.
 Bales are now unlocked after discovering ropes.
 Wooden Bench is now unlocked after building a campfire.
 Cauldron is now unlocked after building a campfire.
 Brazier is now unlocked after crafting a torch.
 Military Tent is now unlocked after building a Basic Tent.
 Comfortable Tent is now unlocked after building a Basic Tent.
 Kitchen Shed is now unlocked after building a Small Shed.
 Healer's Shed is now unlocked after building a Small Shed.
 Siege Shield is now unlocked after building Wooden Spikes.
[/olist]
 Fixed an issue where equipment crafting recipes might not unlock when migrating an existing character to another game world.

Building

 Flat Ground, Slope, Lawn, and Cobblestone build parts have been moved from the Farming > Utilities tab to the Construction > Foundations tab for easier access.
 Wooden stairs can now be stacked twice without requiring support from walls or floors.
 Fixed an issue where wooden poles could interfere with roof placement.
 Fixed an issue where the Lawn build part could have an incorrect opacity value.
 Fixed an issue where multiple Lawn build parts could be stacked on top of each other.

User Interface

 Pressing quickslot hotkey for Wearable Lantern now enables/disables the light instead of equipping/unequipping the lantern.
 Lantern quickslot icon is now highlighted when the light is enabled.
 Toggle visibility button for equipped lantern now allows to hide/unhide the lantern's model without affecting its light. 
This function can be useful if you would like to have the lantern's functionality but don't want it to be visible on the character model.
 Fixed an issue where quickslot bars could be switched unintentionally when using Alt + Mouse Wheel to zoom the camera.
 Fixed an issue where swapping quickslots and switching between quickslot panels could cause the swapped slot to be removed.
 Fixed an issue where a swapped quickslot might cause the incorrect item to be equipped.
 Fixed an issue where multiple quickslot item icons could be highlighted when a weapon was unsheathed.
 Fixed an issue where a queued tutorial pop-up window could appear after returning to the main menu.
 Fixed an issue where map icons were not discovered after migrating an existing character to a new game world.

Audio

 Fixed an issue where dungeon ambient sounds might be overridden by forest ambiance after sunset or sunrise.
 Fixed an issue where combat music might not fade out correctly when summons were present.

Optimization

 Significantly optimized RAM consumption, reducing it by 30% on average.
 Performance optimizations for the game landscape.
 Slightly reduced texture memory consumption.
 Reduced the packaged game size by approximately 7%.
 Reduced game loading time by up to 20%, depending on system configuration.
 Various optimizations for environmental object models.

notes.title: Summoning Update
notes.content:
Magic

 Added new magic glyphs: Touch and Raise Undead.
Touch glyphs can be obtained by defeating Enthralled Foxes, and Raise Undead glyphs can drop from Skeleton Mages.

Dungeons

 Added minimaps for dungeons.
 Added the ability to place build parts inside dungeons. For example, you can build auto-harvesters near resource deposits in dungeons.
 Increased the default dungeon length from 10 to 14 modules for Caves and from 16 to 20 modules for Mines.
 Defeated enemies inside dungeons now respawn after two in-game days.
After clearing the dungeon and re-entering, you may still encounter a few enemies because not all of them spawn at once.
 Resources harvested in dungeons now have the same respawn time as deposits outside, and they are affected by harvesting abilities that increase formation speed.

Treasures

 Added treasure maps that provide hints on how to find hidden treasures.
 Added more types of items that can be found in treasures.
 Adjusted reward scaling from treasure-related skills.
 Hidden treasures can now be dug up without learning the Treasure Hunt skill.

Units

 Skeletons now drop additional loot: Rusty Claymore, Ancient Sword, Ancient Shield, Ancient Dagger, Chaos Staff, Cursed Talisman.
 Added summonable minions:
[olist]
 Skeleton (Fire, Frost, Poison, Lightning, Bloody, Hallowed) - can be summoned using the corresponding Raise Skeleton spell.
 Golem (Fire, Frost, Poison, Lightning, Bone, Hallowed) - can be summoned using the corresponding Raise Golem spell.
[/olist]
 Minion strength depends on the following parameters:
[olist]
 The minion's level and attributes are increased by 1 for every 2 Intelligence points of the caster.
 The minion's base damage is increased by 10% for each Intensity point of the summoning spell.
 The minion's bonus health is increased by 10% for each Magnitude point of the summoning spell.
 The minion's movement speed is increased by 2.5% for each Momentum point of the summoning spell.
[/olist]
 Minions can now apply effect buildups. Summoned skeletons and golems deal physical damage, but their applied effect buildup depends on their elemental type.
 Minions are teleported to the main character if the distance between them is greater than 30 meters.
 Added Enthralled variations for foxes.
 Added a trophy for defeating Skeleton enemies.
 Added a trophy for defeating foxes.
 Enthralled deer can now cast Elemental Orb spells.
 Increased the area of effect for the Skeleton Mage's ability, Chaos Explosion, by 25%.
 Fixed an issue where buildup effects could be applied to training dummies and shooting targets.
 Fixed an issue where unit navigation might stop working in certain cases.

Mounts

 Wild horses are now spawned with random colors (White, Palomino, Brown, Gray, Dark Gray, or Black).
 Increased the number of item slots provided by saddlebags from 18 to 30.
 Fixed an issue where taming a new horse while already having one could overwrite some of the previous data, such as affection value or leveling info.

Inventory

 Added four equipment slots for utility items such as Bags or Wearable Lanterns.
 Fixed an issue where an incorrect item might get removed from the inventory in some cases.
 Fixed an issue where equipping an item from a quickslot wouldn't work after loading a game until the item was re-equipped in the inventory.
 Fixed an issue where using a consumable item from a quickslot might cause the item quantity in the inventory to change incorrectly.
 Fixed an issue where dragging an item into quickslot could override consumable item uses.
 Fixed an issue where the last stack of an item wasn't consumed when used from a quickslot.
 Fixed an issue where quickslot item parameters (such as quantity, charges, quality, etc.) might not get updated.
 Fixed an issue where the item quickslot wasn't removed from the panel after salvaging the item.

Crafting

 Added craftable Tool Bags that have 60 inventory slots and provide bonus experience to harvesting skills. 
They also have a function to automatically store all tools. It's disabled by default but can be toggled by clicking a small button in the top-right corner of the equipped item icon.
 Added craftable Belt Pouches that have 30 inventory slots and grant a bonus duration for consumables. They also have a function to automatically store consumables.
 Added craftable Backpacks that have 60 inventory slots and grant a chance to find additional loot when equipped. They also have a function to automatically store equipment, such as weapons and armor.
 Added Wearable Lanterns that can be attached to the character's belt.
 Added a crafting recipe for Claymore. It can be unlocked after salvaging a Rusty Claymore looted from Skeletons.
 Fixed an issue where crafting recipes might not unlock after obtaining the prerequisite resource in certain cases.
 Fixed an issue where the Cure crafting recipe was missing the Red Mushroom ingredient.

Building

 Added buildable ladders for storage platforms.
 Added buildable beehives. The crafting recipe is unlocked after obtaining Royal Jelly, which has a 25% chance to be found while collecting honey from wild nests.
 Added buildable storage for seeds. It is available under the Farming > Utilities tab and can be unlocked after discovering Lumber.
 Adjusted placement collision on large build parts (such as auto-harvesters) to make them easier to place.

Cooking

 Selecting a recipe from the cookbook will now automatically detect available food ingredients from bags and nearby containers.
 Fixed an issue where automatic ingredient selection might choose item stacks with lower quantities instead of the largest ones.

User Interface

 Added a pause button.
 Added a button to return to the main menu.
 Added a progress bar indicator to the game world loading screen.
 Added the functionality to switch between multiple quickslot panels (up to 9). The default keybinding for switching panels is Mouse Wheel Up/Down.
 Added a new Journal tab, "Summoning," which contains information about minions.
 Added bestiary entries for Skeleton enemies.
 Added a Nutrition parameter to the Detailed Stats, indicating when the character might develop a disease such as Scurvy.
 Portraits and health bars of active minions are now displayed beneath the main character's health bar.
 Character and world selection menus now use alphabetical ordering.
 Fixed an issue where some bestiary entries might contain incorrect information after switching between them.
 Fixed an issue where character selection context menus might have incorrect offsets.
 Fixed an issue where the Quickslot panel couldn't be interacted with while the Journal was open.
 Fixed an issue where some recipe unlocks might be displayed multiple times.

Settings

notes.title: Magic System Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We've uploaded the demo update that adds the magic system to the game. It includes the new Enchanter crafting class with the corresponding equipment. There are also new variations of enemies that have elemental magic and drop spellcrafting materials when defeated.

We plan to add more types of spells and their modifications in the upcoming patches, including summoning magic.

Here is the full list of changes in the update:

Magic System

 Added six Magic Arts:
[olist]
 Ars Goetia - fire magic that is focused on attacking spells and boosting the character's parameters.
 Ars Theurgia - frost magic that is focused on defensive spells and slowing enemies.
 Ars Paulina - poison magic that is focused on dealing damage over time and debilitating enemies.
 Ars Almadel - lightning magic that is focused on high burst damage and AoE spells.
 Ars Necromia - chaos magic that is focused on summoning and durability spells.
 Ars Notoria - holy magic that is focused on healing, dispelling, and utility spells.
[/olist]
 Added basic craftable and customizable spells for all Magic Arts.
 Added perks unlocked by leveling Magic Arts. They can provide various bonuses to selected spells.
 Added a Magic Sigil which allows slotting spells and perks to improve their efficiency.
 Added adjustable spell parameters:
[olist]
 Intensity - each point changes parameters like spell damage, minion strength, or barrier amount by 5%.
 Magnitude - each point changes parameters like maximum projectile range, size, or AoE by 10%.
 Momentum - each point changes parameters like speed, duration, or tick rate by 10%.
 Efficiency - each point changes parameters like spell cost by 7.5%.
[/olist]
 Added materials for spell crafting: Soul Shards, Glyphs, and Runestones.

Combat

 Added a hotkey for toggling aiming mode, defaulted to "F" button. It can be remapped in the Settings. 
This feature enables aiming mode even when using melee weapons, making it useful for spell casting.
 Increased the base Focus Regeneration value from 0.3 to 0.8 FP/sec.
 Significantly reduced the casting delay for Strong Attacks, making them execute almost immediately.
 Further reduced delays after executing Fast Attacks by 0.1 to 0.2 seconds.
 Parrying can now also be activated while blocking by pressing RMB again. The parrying window has been increased.
 Increased the base value of Physical and Elemental Block from 30% to 50%.
 Removed staggering from enemy Fast Attacks.
 Added buildup status effects:
[olist]
 Bleeding - Periodically deals damage based on the target's current health and reduces health regeneration.
 Stunned - Stuns the target for a short period of time and increases the poise damage.
 Ruptured - The target receives damage while moving, which scales based on the distance traveled.
 Staggered - Knocks down the target for a short period of time and reduces the resistance to staggering.
 Burning - Deals damage over time and increases delays between enemy attacks.
 Frozen - Freezes the target for a short period of time and then slows down attack and movement speed.
 Poisoned - Reduces enemy damage and inflicts damage that gradually increases over time.
 Shocked - Increases the critical hit chance against the target and slows down stamina and focus regeneration.
 Frightened - The enemy has reduced physical resistances and a chance to fumble an attack, dealing only half of the damage.
 Purged - Removes a positive effect from the target and temporarily increases all damage received.
[/olist]
 Added immunity to bleeding for Undead enemies.
 Fixed an issue where the enemy Charge attack might not be executed.
 Fixed an issue where attacks or hotkeys might not work after being staggered by an enemy in some cases.
 Fixed an issue where enemy attacks could consume more stamina than intended.
 Fixed an issue where negative resistances might not increase the damage received.
 Fixed an issue where enemy rotation might be incorrect while casting spells.

Enemies

 Added enemies with magic abilities that drop materials for spellcrafting when defeated.

Quests

 Added a tutorial quest for basic magic usage.
 Implemented additional checks to ensure that the Harvesting Resources quest is always received.
 Fixed an issue where disabling tutorial pop-up windows before starting a new game could prevent the initial tutorial quest from appearing.

Inventory

 Fixed an issue where equipped items weren't dropped on the ground when they were unequipped and the inventory was full.

Places of Interest

 Added Shrines containing elemental Soul Shards and granting blessings that increase experience gained in Magic Arts.
 Fixed an issue where some Places of Interest might have incorrect respawn times.

Resources

 Added harvestable Enchantment Crystals, which can be used to craft Enchanter's equipment. When harvested, these crystals will respawn after some time.
 Automation tools now provide harvesting experience for each collected resource.
 Fixed an issue where Stove resource processing was interrupted after the first 2-3%.

Crafting

 Added a new craftable item type: Elemental Staves.
 Fixed an issue where upgrading an item that was assigned to a quickslot might cause the upgrades not to apply.
 Fixed an issue where crafting an item while having a similar one in a quickslot might not update the quantity correctly.

Building

 Added Enchanter's tools:
[olist]
 Spellcrafting Workbench - allows creating new magic spells.
 Arcane Sphere - allows to apply modifications to spells.
 Melting Reservoir - allows salvaging materials from existing spells.
 Mystic Reliquary - allows adjusting spell parameters.
 Enchanting Table - allows enchanting basic equipment such as weapons, armor, and accessories.
 Rune Altar - allows to add extra effects to spells.
[/olist]
 Reduced the building cost of wood and stone foundations from 5 to 2.
 Reduced the building cost of floors and triangle foundations from 3 to 1.
 Reduced the building cost of wood walls from 4 lumber to 2, and from 3 clay to 2.
 Reduced the building cost of short walls from 2 lumber to 1.
 Reduced the building cost of door and window frames from 5 lumber to 4.
 Reduced the building cost of wood stairs from 5 to 3.
 Reduced the building cost of thatch roofs from 4 grain to 2.
 Reduced the building cost of corner thatch roofs from 5 grain to 3, and from 3 lumber to 2.
 Reduced the building cost of inner corner thatch roofs from 6 grain to 4, and from 4 lumber to 2.
 Reduced the building cost of flat thatch roofs from 4 grain to 2.
 Reduced the building cost of triangle thatch roofs from 3 grain to 2.
 Reduced the building cost of cobblestone from 2 to 1.
 Increased the building cost of wood doors from 3 to 4.
 Fixed an issue where some building materials, such as animal hides, might be displayed as missing even when there are sufficient quantities.

User Interface

 Unlocked the Magic Arts tab.
 Added a hotkey for opening the Magic Arts menu ("N" by default). It can be remapped in the Settings.
 Added bestiary entries for Enthralled enemies.
 Fixed an issue where two-handed weapons didn't occupy the off-hand slot after loading the game.
 Fixed an issue where swapping an item quickslot with an ability quickslot might cause the ability icon to disappear.
 Fixed an issue where a notification about not having enough Stamina wasn't displayed when ammunition was enabled.

Audio

 Added sounds for error messages regarding missing Stamina and Focus.

Settings

 Fixed an issue where custom camera offsets might not be loaded in some cases.

Hotfix 1

 Added a new tutorial video that shows how to collect Enchantment Crystals.
 Fixed an issue where the Magic Basics quest objectives weren't auto-completed if they were done before receiving the quest.
 Fixed an issue where, in some cases, dungeon walls could be generated in a way that led to the character getting stuck.
 Fixed an issue where the rifle's melee attack also consumed ammunition.
 Cooldowns for collecting resources from animals are now reset after switching to a new game world.
 Fixed an issue where items in prebuilt houses would respawn after re-entering them.
 Fixed an issue where items stored in prebuilt containers (inside farms or in the destroyed village) weren't saved.
 Fixed an issue where resource containers (baskets or sacks) in the destroyed village respawned after reloading the game.
 Fixed an issue where element selection buttons in the Bestiary were not reset after switching between enemy types.
 Removed the console key mapping from Num 0. The console can still be opened using the Tilde button (~).

notes.title: Demo Build 0.1.0.2d
notes.content:
Tutorials

 Crafting and building tutorial quest objectives are now automatically completed if the object was crafted or built previously.
 Attribute and skill distribution tutorial quest objectives are now automatically completed if they were leveled up previously.
 The tutorial quest "Processing Resources" is divided into two separate quests.
 Added a new tutorial stage that requires harvesting fuel and building a Hauling Machine before making a Bloomery.
 Added a new tutorial stage that requires building a Tar Kiln and obtaining tar before making a Debarker.
 Updated the tutorial description about harvesting wood to indicate that large trees require better equipment to be harvested and cannot be chopped early in the game.
 Updated the tutorial description about harvesting iron ore to make it clearer.

Combat

 Added bonus damage to all types of ammunition.
 Strong attacks with ranged weapons now require Stamina even when ammunition is enabled.
 Fixed an issue where the game might sometimes crash when attempting to execute reload and dodge at the same time.

Movement

 Added an auto-run option that can be toggled using the "Num Lock" button by default. The hotkey can be changed in the Settings menu.
Pressing Move Forward, Backwards, Left, or Right will cancel autorun.
 Toggle Walking hotkey ("Caps Lock" by default) changed to Movement Mode and now allows you to switch between 3 movement modes: Walking, Running, and Sprinting. Sprinting mode allows the character to always sprint without the need to hold the "Shift" button and also works when autorun is enabled.
 Fixed an issue where pressing the Sprint button while riding a horse would always deplete stamina, even when the horse wasn't moving.
 Fixed an issue where the character's looking direction might be incorrect while riding a horse and Strafing rotation mode is enabled.

Abilities

Save Games

User Interface

Animals

Building

notes.title: Demo Build 0.1.0.2c
notes.content:
Tutorials

 The tutorial for building a tent now accepts any type of shed or tent, not just the basic one.

Combat

 Added ammunition types and reloading mechanics for all ranged weapons.
Ammunition replaces Stamina cost for ranged abilities when enabled.
At the moment, it's an experimental feature and can be toggled in the settings.
 Added second and third combo moves for all melee default attacks: Sword, Blunt Weapon, and Polearm.
 Added a parry ability for Unarmed combat.
 Added a visual indicator to show when the enemy attack can be parried. It can be toggled on and off in the Settings menu.
 Added a visual indicator for strong and charge enemy attacks that cannot be parried and immobilize the character on hit. It can be toggled on and off in the Settings menu.
 Added a knockdown effect to successful parries.
 Character movement speed is now preserved after dodging.
 Changed the first combo move for Sword, Blunt Weapon, and Polearm default attacks.
 When only the first combo ability is learned, it will automatically transition into the default combo. 
When two or more combo abilities are learned, they will be used in a cycle without switching to the default one (the same way it worked before). 
This change is aimed to prevent situations where the character could only use a single attack and to make combat more fluid.
 Changed Suppression rifle ability damage type from Ballistic to Piercing.
 Changed Bayonet Attack rifle ability damage type from Piercing to Slashing.
 Changed default rifle attack damage type from Ballistic to Piercing.
 Increased damage of Parry attacks by 100% and effect buildup by 50%.
 Reduced transition time from Sidestep/Evade to combat abilities by 0.3 seconds.
 Reduced transition time from combat abilities to Sidestep/Evade by 0.3-0.8 seconds, depending on the ability length.
 Adjusted the animation length and speed of Sidestep abilities to make them more consistent.
 Improved bullet tracing against moving targets.
 Increased the physical block bonus for the Iron Buckler item from 3-6% to 10-20% and added an extra armor affix.
 Fixed an issue where the aiming target lock might be active when there were no combat targets.
 Fixed an issue where some default attacks didn't apply effect buildup.
 Fixed an issue where Guard tooltip was shown instead of Aim when ranged weapons were equipped.

Enemies

 Added a Strong Attack to Skeleton Mages.
 Adjusted timings of some enemy abilities.
 Increased the Strong Attack cooldown for foxes.
 Adjusted ground friction for rat bodies to reduce rolling on slopes.
 Fixed an issue where Bandit Thieves couldn't execute melee attacks in some cases.

Mounts

 Fixed an issue where horse equipment icons weren't updated correctly after unequipping saddlebags.
 Fixed an issue where horse equipment items could be unequipped after loading in some cases.

Resources

 Added fixed spawns for all types of domestic animals in the Woodlands area.
 Added Truffles, an item that can be collected from domesticated pigs.
 Increased all storage sizes from 30 to 50.
 Increased Log Storage, Lumber Storage, and Tar Storage sizes from 30 to 100.
 Increased Granary storage size from 100 to 200.
 Increased skill experience gain from collecting herbs, fibers, and grains.
 Reduced the damage from falling trees but added a brief knockdown effect if they hit the character.
 Harvesting vegetables, fruits, and animal products now provides bonus Farming skill experience.
 Fixed an issue where automation tools could cause a memory leak when updating resource quantities.
 Fixed an issue where interaction tooltips were still displayed even after a resource deposit was harvested.
 Fixed an issue where timers for collecting products from domestic animals were reset after restarting the game.

Harvesting Skills

 Abilities that provided bonus experience have been moved to the beginning of the skill tree.
 Abilities that previously provided a chance to find unique resources from normal deposits now instead increase the yield of resources from unique deposits.
In future updates we plan to add unique resource deposits to specific locations in all regions and unlock mechanics related to them (advanced crafting, socketing, reforging, enhancement).
 Digging up hidden treasures is available in the Woodlands region. The Dark Forest and dungeons don't contain hidden treasures in the current build. 
There are 8 spots in total. Treasures respawn after some time, so it's not necessary to wait until all treasure-related skills are fully leveled out to obtain the maximum benefit.
 Enabled all abilities that provide seeds when harvesting a plant.
 Woodcutting abilities:
[olist]
 Replenishment - moved from the 3rd slot to the 1st. Added a visual effect for restoring Stamina.
 Limbing - increased chance to obtain extra wood from 4/8/12/16% to 5/10/15/20%. Added a visual effect when receiving a bonus resource.
 Steady Swing - moved from the 1st slot to the 3rd.
 Exotic Wood - now increases the amount of Precious Wood obtained from unique trees by 25/50/75/100%.
[/olist]
 Mining abilities:
[olist]
 Precision - moved from the 3rd slot to the 1st. Added a visual effect when an ore deposit is split in one hit.
 Sturdy Hit - moved from the 1st slot to the 3rd.
 Ore Gathering - updated the ability description to clarify that the bonus is applied to ore pieces found near deposits.
 Survey - provides a chance to find precious metals when picking up iron ore pieces. Increased the chance from 5/10/15/20% to 10/20/30/40%.
 Extraction - updated the ability description.
 Shard Mining - now increases the amount of Shards obtained from unique ore deposits by 25/50/75/100%.
 Conservation - increased iron ore deposit replenishment speed from 15/20/25/30% to 20/30/40/50%.
 Prospecting - increased the chance to obtain precious metals from harvesting iron ore deposits from 10/20/30/40% to 20/40/60/80%.
[/olist]
 Quarrying abilities:
[olist]
 Targeted Blow - now increases the quarrying experience gain and provides a chance to break stone deposits in one hit. Added a visual effect when a stone deposit is split in one hit.
 Heavy Hit - added a visual effect for hits with increased power.
 Stone Cutting - now reduces stamina cost when harvesting stone from deposits by 12.5/25/37.5/50% and provides a 5/10/15/20% chance to obtain extra stone blocks.
 Shockwave - now increases the sledgehammer hit area by 25/50/75/100% and harvesting speed by 5/10/15/20%. Added a visual effect for area hits.
 Demolition - updated the ability description.
 Excavation - increases the amount of stone and fuel collected from pieces near deposits by 25/50/75/100%.
 Ornamental Stones - now increases the amount of Ornamental Stones obtained from unique stone deposits by 25/50/75/100%.
 Fuel Gathering - now provides a 20/40/60/80% chance to also obtain fuel when harvesting stone deposits.
 Coal Mining - increases the amount of extra fuel that can be obtained when harvesting stone deposits by 100/200/300/400%.
 Blast Mining - hitting fuel deposits with explosives such as hand mortar rounds or grenades has a 12/20/28/36% chance to provide a piece of fuel.
[/olist]
 Digging abilities:
[olist]
 Efficient Digging - moved from the 1st slot to the 3rd.
 Fissure - changed the chance from 6/9/12/15% to 5/10/15/20% and increased Stamina recovery bonus from 4/6/8/10 to 8/12/16/20. Added a visual effect for Stamina recovery.
 Attainment - moved from the 3rd slot to the 1st. Experience bonus is now doubled after finding a treasure.
 Scoop - now also increases clay harvesting speed by 5/10/15/20%. Added a visual effect.
 Unearthing - now increases the amount of Elements obtained from unique deposits by 25/50/75/100%.
 Treasure Hunt - now increases the amount of loot from treasures instead of the digging area.
[/olist]
 Splitting abilities:
[olist]
 Precise Split - moved from the 1st slot to the 3rd.
 Erosion - updated the ability description.
 Splinter - moved from the 3rd slot to the 1st. Added a visual effect when receiving a bonus resource.
 Puncturing Strike - provides a 6/12/18/24% chance to deal double damage when attacking enemies or harvesting deposits with a splitting bar. Added a visual effect.
 Dispersal - updated the ability description.
 Gemstones - now increases the amount of Gemstones obtained from unique deposits by 25/50/75/100%.
 Formation - increased salt deposit replenishment speed from 10/20/30/40% to 20/30/40/50%.
 Concentration - salt deposits have higher concentrations, increasing the minimum amount of harvested salts by 1/2/3/4.
 Crystallization - unique deposits that contain Gemstones replenish 20/30/40/50% faster and provide 5/10/15/20% more resources.
[/olist]
 Farming abilities:
[olist]
 Accurate Slash - moved from the 1st slot to the 3rd.
 Powerful Scything - consecutive slashes with a scythe consume up to 10/20/30/40% less Stamina and deal up to 12.5/25/37.5/50% more damage.
 Perfect Cut - moved from the 3rd slot to the 1st.
 Sweeping Hit - now increases Critical Hit Chance by 6/12/18/24% when using a scythe in combat or while harvesting crops.
 Planting - increased the chance to obtain plant seeds from 20/30/40/50% to 30/45/60/75%.
 Gardening - increased the chance to obtain plant seeds from 15/30/45/60% to 30/45/60/75%.
 Fertility - grains, vegetables, and fruits that you plant have a 25/50/75/100% higher growth speed.
[/olist]
 Reaping abilities:
[olist]
 Swipe - moved from the 3rd slot to the 1st. Now provides bonus experience and a 4/8/12/16% chance to collect an extra fiber with each hit.
 Reinvigorate - rescaled the bonuses considering that fibers now contain several plants instead of a single one. Added a visual effect for Stamina recovery.
 Nimble Reaping - moved from the 1st slot to the 3rd.
 Thoroughness - collecting fibers provides a 10/20/30/40% chance to obtain an extra resource.
 Stiffness - now applies to all fiber plants and increases durability by 20/40/60/80% instead of 25/50/75/100%.
 Sowing - increased the chance to obtain plant seeds from 20/30/40/50% to 30/45/60/75%.
 Flourish - fibers that you plant have a 25/50/75/100% higher growth speed than wild ones.
[/olist]
 Gathering abilities:
[olist]
 Expertise - moved from the 3rd slot to the 1st.
 Remedy - now always recovers a fixed amount of Health after harvesting a herb. The bonuses have been rescaled considering that herbs now contain several plants instead of a single one. Added a visual effect for Health recovery.
 Exact Cut - moved from the 1st slot to the 3rd.
 Carefulness - rescaled the chance to obtain an extra herb with each hit from 5/10/15/20% to 4/8/12/16%.
 Herbalism - now increases the amount of harvested unique Herbs, Toxins, and Mutagens by 25/50/75/100%.
 Growing - increased the chance to obtain plant seeds from 20/30/40/50% to 30/45/60/75%.
[/olist]
 Hoeing abilities:
[olist]
 Surge - moved from the 3rd slot to the 1st. Now instantly restores 8/12/16/20 Stamina upon harvesting a pigment. Added a visual effect for Stamina recovery.
 Softening -  updated the ability description.
 Skilled Tilling - moved from the 1st slot to the 3rd.
 Wide Span - now also increases pigment harvesting speed by 5/10/15/20%. Added a visual effect for area hits.
 Chroma - unique deposits also have a 12.5/25/37.5/50% chance to contain special pigments that modify the properties of dyes.
[/olist]
 Fixed an issue where some harvesting abilities could be leveled up before the previous ability in the skill tree was unlocked.
 Fixed an issue where Wild Wheat, Cotton, and Mugwort plants didn't drop seeds.

Crafting

 Added craftable ammunition and the corresponding global storage tab.
 Added an option to automatically craft ammunition when it reaches a specified threshold.
 Adjusted all item sell prices.
 Slightly adjusted crafting costs for some items.

Building Mode

 Added an option to move placed build parts.
 Added an alternative grid-based UI for the Building Menu.
 Added an option to toggle the display of the building radius.
 Added buildable storage platforms that can be stacked vertically and contain up to 4 storages. They also provide a 100% bonus to storage capacity.
They are available under the Farming => Utilities category.

 Adjusted collision for the Wood Pole build part.

 Fixed an issue where destroying a foundation or flat ground that supports other build parts could cause them to hang in the air.
Now, if the distance to the ground is less than one meter, the build part will drop safely, and if it's more, then it will be destroyed.

User Interface

 Added an option to hide undiscovered items in the Crafting Menu.
 Added a checkbox that allows skipping confirmation windows when salvaging items.
 Added interaction tooltips for harvesting equipment.
 Added tooltips to category buttons in the compact resource menu.
 Ability points can now be allocated and redistributed without the need to press the "Assign Points" button. 
Respeccing ability points is free and available at any point in the game. 
The permanent choices for characters will come from combat classes and specializations instead.
 Improved the responsiveness of the ability points allocation interface.
 Removed interaction tooltips for fallen trees and harvested resource deposits.
 Changed Earthenware and Terracotta resource names to Earthenware Clay and Terracotta Clay.
 Fixed an issue where upgrading the skill from 3rd level to 4th level might not work in some cases.
 Fixed an issue where the parry attack type wasn't displayed in the ability tooltip.
 Fixed an issue where the Alternative Attack tooltip showed only the Alt key instead of Alt+LMB.
 Fixed an issue where dragging resources from inventory to container might cause switching to the incorrect resource tab.
 Fixed an issue where the Take All button might not transfer all resource stacks in some cases.
 Fixed an issue where mouse and interaction viewport focus might be lost after closing certain menus.
 Fixed an issue where Building Menu tooltips were displayed after closing the menu.
 Fixed an issue where closing the Settings menu with unassigned key bindings could cause camera issues.

Settings

 Added a button to reset key bindings to default values.
 Added sliders for adjusting nighttime and overcast brightness.
 Added new hotkeys:
[olist]
 Reload - "R"
 Move Build Part - "F"
 Toggle Build Radius - "R" (when pointing at a build part)
 Destroy Build Part - "Del"
[/olist]
 Added new gameplay settings:
[olist]
 Movement Rotation Mode (Turning/Strafing)
 Ammunition (On/Off)
 Parrying Indicators (On/Off)
 Strong Attack Indicators (On/Off)
 Building Menu Mode (Radial/Grid)
[/olist]
 Fixed an issue where input tooltips weren't displayed properly when the corresponding key was unmapped.
 Fixed an issue where the "Not Assigned" message sometimes wasn't displayed for unmapped keys.

Audio

 Replaced Sword, Blunt Weapon, and Polearm hit sounds with more impactful ones.

Other

 Camera rotation is now reset on character respawn or using Unstuck button to prevent accidental camera tilting.

notes.title: Demo Build 0.1.0.2b
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! We uploaded the 0.1.0.2b which includes a lot of bug fixes and other changes. It features a reworked tutorial system, with much more detailed explanations and videos. There are also improvements in almost all gameplay systems that are based on the feedback that we received since the demo launch.

We plan to release one more patch with fixes and quality-of-life improvements after this one, and then focus on content updates for the demo. The upcoming patch will include functionality to move existing build parts, an alternative inventory-based UI for the building menu, and more types of default weapon attacks.

The full list of changes in the current patch:

Demo Build 0.1.0.2b

Tutorials

 Reworked existing tutorials to a new format with videos and more detailed explanations.
 All tutorials are now presented in a fixed order for easier progression. The horse taming tutorial is still available separately upon discovering a wild horse.
 The Destroyed Village quest line unlocks only after completing or skipping the tutorials.

Resources

 Increased the guaranteed amount of rare resource pieces (clay, fuel, pigments, salts, precious ore) near deposits to 4-5.
 Increased the chance of finding common resource pieces (stone, iron ore) near deposits from 100%/50%/25% to 100%/100%/75%.
 Wild plants (fibers, herbs, crops) are now generated in groups of several plants instead of a single one.
 Holding E now allows to automatically continue resource harvesting.
 Rat pelts can now be used to produce leather.
 Added guaranteed herb and fiber resource spawns near the starting location.
 Fixed an issue where auto-equipping an axe might not work with bushes.
 Fixed an issue where resource pieces might not spawn near the character after loading the game.
 Fixed an issue where a tool wasn't auto-equipped when holding a weapon.
 Fixed an issue where trees could regrow through obstacles in some cases.
 Fixed an issue where the type of resource deposit could change after an update or alterations to the world seed value.
 Fixed an issue where saplings could respawn if they were harvested using the Interact button before they grew.
 Fixed an issue where resource deposit pieces and minimap icons could sometimes become hidden when the character was close.

Environment

 Increased global light brightness.

 Improved collision for Hazel shrub destructible pieces.

Combat

Enemies

Mounts

Crafting

In later versions of the game, the Apothecary crafting profession will be unlocked, and this item will be replaced by multiple recipes.
 Fixed an issue where upgrading an equipped item didn't update its description.

Building Mode

 Increased the size of the basic tent.
 Updated the building category name for pelts and sleeping bags.
 Fixed an issue where some build parts durability might reset to 1 after loading.
 Fixed an issue where build parts might not refund the full building cost in some cases.
 Fixed an issue where placing a Tar Kiln near a Debarker connected to a Circular Saw could break the connection.
 Fixed an issue where Leather Racks weren't resuming production automatically after loading.

Prebuilt Houses

User Interface

This can be useful to check active status effects, reorder quickslots, or check ability and item tooltips.
